duplicate_policy: Reject ambiguous duplicate source keys; do not silently drop or average records
imputation: No missing identities, coordinates, activity or faults are manufactured

events.message: Actual resource descriptors extracted from official HTML; these are NOT infrastructure observations.
Pinned licensed historical archive. Original source-key joins only. Observation dates are not inferred from commit date.
One-sided source links are retained and flagged. Missing landing details use exact original country-membership keys where available, never inferred countries.
Named cable entries extracted from OFCA HTML prose and reconciled against its published count. Not HTML table rows, global inventory or fault events.
Verified unchanged, licensed infrastructure snapshot loaded.
All officially listed EEZ context regions selected before examining activity. Joint/overlapping areas retained separately; high seas excluded.
